name: Negative control: discovery tool names as data only (no T1082 detection)
description: Writes the NAMES of discovery utilities into a scratch file, reads and counts it, then deletes it. No discovery utility is executed. Ground truth: NOT system information discovery; it proves the Linux discovery rules match the executed binary, not words on a command line.
command:
echo "hostname uname ps who date timedatectl" > /tmp/jisrsec-ctl.txt
cat /tmp/jisrsec-ctl.txt
wc -w /tmp/jisrsec-ctl.txt
approval_note: JISRSEC negative control (benign, writes only a scratch file in /tmp)
